articles.summary: LAGOS, 5 June 2023 — Helium Health (the Company), a Lagos-headquartered healthtech company providing Software-as-a-service (SaaS) tools, financing, and insights to healthcare providers and public health organizations, announced today it has raised $30M in Series-B funding.
